content.h2: What changed for a site that moved to DronaHost

items.a: Cloud web hosting at DronaHost means your site runs on infrastructure from leading cloud providers. DronaHost owns no servers or data centers, and no plan is tied to one provider or location. You choose one of four plans, each with set resources and a published price.

items.q: How is cloud hosting different from shared hosting?
items.a: On shared hosting, many sites draw on one server's resources. At DronaHost, every plan runs on infrastructure from leading cloud providers, and your plan sets how much of it you share. Starter and Growth use shared resources. Pro uses semi-dedicated resources, and Scale uses dedicated resources that no other site draws on.

No. You manage your site in a control panel, and DronaHost runs the hosting account, its monitoring and its daily backup. You never set up or run a server. That is what managed cloud hosting for small business means here: we run the hosting, you run the site.

items.q: How much does cloud hosting cost for a small business?
items.a: The cost depends on the plan you choose. The plan cards on this page show each price in your currency, with the renewal price beside it, so you see the full cost before you buy. Paying yearly costs less per month than paying monthly. Prices exclude tax. Customers in India pay GST at checkout.

items.q: Will my bill change with traffic or at renewal?
items.a: Your price does not rise at renewal. Every plan renews at your signup price for the same billing cycle, with no end date. Plans do not scale on their own, so a busy month does not move you to a larger plan.

items.q: What happens when my site outgrows its plan?
items.a: You move up to a larger plan. Plans do not scale automatically, so your resources stay fixed until you change plan. The plan guide on this page shows what each larger plan adds. If your site needs more than Scale, the team scopes a high-traffic plan with you, with no published price.

Every plan has a 99.99% uptime SLA backed by service credits. If uptime falls below that in a month, you can claim a credit, and the SLA explains how we measure uptime and how to claim. Every plan also includes server monitoring.

Support runs 24/7 by ticket and email, so every reply is in writing. DronaHost does not offer live chat or phone support. Growth adds priority support, and Scale adds senior experts. The support policy sets out what support covers. Open a ticket from the contact page.

items.q: How is this different from your other hosting?
items.a: Cloud hosting, WordPress hosting and Business hosting use the same four plans at the same prices. This page covers our cloud hosting services for small business, for owners who want room to grow. Choose by the size of your site, not the page name. For full server control, see Managed VPS hosting.
